import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD

r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")


tfidf=TfidfVectorizer();X=tfidf.fit_transform(r.text)
svd=TruncatedSVD(n_components=50,random_state=0);Z=svd.fit_transform(X)
Zn=Z/np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1,keepdims=True)
keys=list(desc);V=svd.transform(tfidf.transform([desc[k] for k in keys]))
V=V/np.linalg.norm(V,axis=1,keepdims=True)
zs_pred=np.array(keys)[(Zn@V.T).argmax(axis=1)]
zs_acc=round(float((zs_pred==r.topic).mean()),3)
base_acc=round(float(r.topic.value_counts(normalize=True).iloc[0]),3)
